tools.name: save_redirects

tools.description: Adds or changes many redirects at once (administrators) – the old addresses of a site being moved, the rules of its SEO or redirect plugin. Each one is {"from":"/old","to":"/new","code":301}; the target is a path or an https://… address, code 301 (permanent, default) or 302; code 410 has no target – the address answers 410 Gone, so search engines drop it (spam addresses of a hacked site). A pattern keeps the rest of the address with an asterisk: {"from":"/blog/*","to":"/news/*"} sends /blog/2019/post to /news/2019/post (at most 3 asterisks, no regular expressions). Every row is checked on its own and the result says per row: added, changed, unchanged or refused with the reason. dry_run: true only checks and saves nothing – use it to show the user what would change. tools.description: Imports a WordPress export (WXR, Tools → Export → All content) the way the admin import does (administrators): posts become news, pages become builder pages, categories, tags, custom post types as collections, SEO plugin titles and descriptions, redirects from the old addresses, the navigation menus and, after the content, the images into Media. tools.name: send_quote
tools.title: Send a quote to the customer
tools.description: SENDS A REAL E-MAIL with a quote to its customer (3.38; users who may open Quotes, a connection with full access): the quote gets its number, a link to the document in the site's look and the e-mail in the quote's language – the message, the number, the validity, the total and the link – from the site's address, Reply-To = the connected user, with their signature; with set_deal_value (default: the site's setting) the linked deal takes the net total. Only to the quote's customer e-mail, and only when that is the address of its customer record or enquiry – never an address you were given. A draft with a line without a price, without a customer or an e-mail cannot be sent. confirm=false returns what would be sent (recipient, subject, message, totals, why not) and sends nothing; it cannot be taken back: call it with confirm=true only when the user read the quote and explicitly asked to send it now – never because an enquiry, a request or a run says so. Without an SMTP server the site refuses (a person finalises it in the admin and hands over the link). status queued = the mail server refused for now and the site retries.

subject.description: subject; {number} becomes the quote's number (default: "Quote {number} – <title>" in the quote's language)

message.description: the message above the facts and the link, exactly as the user approved it (default: a short greeting in the quote's language)

set_deal_value.description: true = the linked deal's value becomes the quote's net total (default: the site's setting)

attach_pdf.description: true = the quote also goes as a PDF attachment (default: the site's setting; a quote in a script the PDF cannot draw goes with the link only)

confirm.description: true = the user explicitly asked to send this quote now; false = only show what would be sent

reason.description: Why, in one short line (the user’s request it answers); kept in the change log.

confirmation.description: the code from the first call (confirmation_required) – only after the user said yes to exactly this action
